subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group chats gain opt-in automatic per-sender durable agents, or should OpenClaw keep group chats on session/topic routing plus explicit agent bindings?
rationale: The requested behavior is not a narrow bug fix; it creates durable agents and changes security, cost, memory, skills, config, and message-routing boundaries for group participants.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in Feishu plugin design
options.body: Approve a scoped design for group-sender dynamic agents with explicit admin enablement, quotas, cleanup, permissions, and live Feishu validation.

options.title: Split into narrower issues
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only as product context and move implementation to smaller items for routing, lifecycle, memory, and user-skill policy.

options.title: Decline automatic group agents
options.body: Document the supported path as groupSessionScope plus explicit bindings/subagent thread use, avoiding automatic durable agent creation from group traffic.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in Feishu plugin design
recommendation.body: Approve a scoped design for group-sender dynamic agents with explicit admin enablement, quotas, cleanup, permissions, and live Feishu validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names @m1heng as the community owner, and the decision is Feishu-specific product/security direction.
